g1.label: 1. New York is the most famous ___
g1.why: A place people travel to is a destination.

g2.label: 2. the Statue of ___
g2.why: The famous statue in New York harbour is the Statue of Liberty.

g3.label: 3. It was a ___ from France
g3.why: Something given for free is a gift; France gave the statue in 1886.

g4.label: 4. bigger than many ___ in Europe
g4.why: Central Park is a park, so it is compared with other parks.

g5.label: 5. runners, families and street ___
g5.why: People who play music in the street are musicians.

g6.label: 6. faster than a ___
g6.why: The subway is compared with a taxi, the other way to cross the city.

g7.label: 7. one of the oldest ___ in America
g7.why: Boston is famous for its old universities, such as Harvard.

g8.label: 8. the most exciting ___ of the USA
g8.why: A region of a country is a part of it.

g1.label: 1. New York is ___ than Boston
g1.why: Short adjectives add -er before 'than': big → bigger.

g2.label: 2. The subway is ___ than the bus
g2.why: One-syllable adjectives take -er, not 'most' or the plain form.

g3.label: 3. Central Park is ___ than I expected
g3.why: Adjectives of three syllables take 'more', never -er.

g4.label: 4. Winter in Boston is ___ than Miami
g4.why: Short adjectives form the comparative with -er: cold → colder.

g6.label: 6. The weather today is ___ than yesterday

g7.label: 7. A ferry ticket is ___ than a taxi
g7.why: 'Than' needs a comparative, so cheap becomes cheaper.

g8.label: 8. The streets here are ___
g8.why: Adjectives ending in consonant + y change y to i and add -er.

g1.label: 1. one of the ___ buildings
g1.why: Superlatives use 'the' + -est to pick one out of a group.

g3.label: 3. the ___ place in the city
g3.why: Consonant + y changes to i before -est: busy → busiest.

g4.label: 4. the ___ museum in Boston
g4.why: Adjectives of two or more syllables take 'the most', not -est.

g5.label: 5. the ___ pizza I have ever eaten
g5.why: One-syllable adjectives double the final consonant: big → biggest.

g6.label: 6. the ___ month of the year
g6.why: Short adjectives form the superlative with -est after 'the'.

g7.label: 7. the ___ way to travel
g7.why: 'Quick' is short, so the superlative is quickest, not 'most quick'.
